## Filtering

Note that values used for filtering here are based on results in the data exploration section above. So it and the data exploration section should either be combined in the final case study draft, or we'll add a note about people needing to visit the data exploration step to under the values we're using.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
scz_spatial <- filter_data(scz_spatial,
                           spot_minreads=50,
                           spot_maxreads=3000,
                           spot_mingenes=10,
                           spot_maxgenes = 185)
```

## Normalizing

We're using a log transform. Another option is the SCTransform which we'll explain in a click to expand section. We can even compare the two normalization methods (but I'll have to make two separate `STlist`'s for that)

```{r, eval = FALSE}
scz_spatial <- transform_data(scz_spatial, method='log', cores=2)
```

We can visualize the distribution of expression of a couple of genes (before and after the normalization) using the `distribution_plots()` function.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
raw_plots <- distribution_plots(scz_spatial, genes = c("CX3CR1", "FKBP5", "SST"), data_type = "raw")

transformed_plots <- distribution_plots(scz_spatial, genes = c("CX3CR1", "FKBP5", "SST"), data_type = "tr)

raw_plots$CX3CR1 + transformed_plots$CX3CR1 + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```
![](img/crx3cr1_expression_before_after.png){fig-alt="Two panels with six violin plots each showing the distribution of the CX3CR1 gene prior to normalization and after normalization for each sample."}

```{r, eval = FALSE}
raw_plots$FKBP5 + transformed_plots$FKBP5 + plot_layout(guides="collect")
```

![](img/fkbp5_expression_before_after.png){fig-alt="Two panels with six violin plots each showing the distribution of the FKBP5 gene prior to normalization and after normalization for each sample."}

```{r, eval = FALSE}
raw_plots$SST + transformed_plots$SST + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

![](img/sst_expression_before_after.png){fig-alt="Two panels with six violin plots each showing the distribution of the SST gene prior to normalization and after normalization for each sample."}

```{r, eval = FALSE}
saveRDS(scz_spatial, here("data/wrangled/scz_spatial.rds"))
```
